controls.reasoning_effort: medium (same for all modes and both rule variants)
controls.tool_permissions: Same testcase-specific tool policy and runner catalog for both rules.
controls.execution_environment: GitHub Actions ubuntu-24.04 with Python 3.12.14; actual Actions runtime is not yet tested.
controls.conversation_state: Fresh independent Requests API context per run; store=false; no previous_response_id or conversation_id.

tool_parity.evidence: Both rule variants use the same per-testcase local tool catalog, hosted web_search configuration, tool disables, fault injections, and fixture bytes. Live API-side behavior remains untested.

independent_state.evidence: Each run creates a fresh input array, does not send previous_response_id or conversation_id, and sets store=false. This is statically implemented, not yet tested on GitHub Actions.

execution_trace.evidence: API smoke records the real forced function_call response and appends the deterministic local diagnostic result; benchmark runner records API responses, hosted web_search events, function calls/results, errors, and timestamps. No live API trace has been obtained.

persistence.credential_source: GitHub Actions default github.token with contents: write

api_credential.source: GitHub Actions Secret, injected only into api_smoke and pilot steps
